insurer_name: Aditya Birla Health Insurance Co. Limited

critical_illness_cover.limit_text: Lump-sum benefit for cancer diagnosis (any stage). Covers Minor Stage Cancer (25% SI), Major Stage Cancer (100% SI). Reinstatement of SI after 180 days.
critical_illness_cover.notes: Defined-benefit (fixed payout) plan focused exclusively on cancer. Pays on diagnosis confirmed by histopathology.

inpatient_hospitalization.notes: This is a benefit (fixed-payout) plan, not indemnity. Pays lump sum on diagnosis, not hospitalization expenses.

permanent_exclusions: Cancer diagnosed within 90-day waiting period (initial waiting)
Pre-existing cancer / pre-existing diseases until 48-month waiting
Carcinoma-in-situ, pre-malignant tumors, low-grade tumors (TNM stage T1N0M0)
Non-melanoma skin cancers without lymph node invasion
Malignant melanoma without invasion beyond epidermis
Prostate tumors with Gleason ≤6 or TNM ≤T2N0M0
Thyroid cancer classified T1N0M0 or below
Chronic lymphocytic leukaemia less than RAI stage 3
All tumors in presence of HIV infection
Cancer due to nuclear / war / chemical events
notable_exclusions_summary: Cancer-specific fixed-benefit plan. Pays lump sum on diagnosis of Major Stage Cancer (or 25% for Minor Stage). Survival period typically 30 days post-diagnosis. Premium waiver for remaining policy term after Major Stage claim. Reinstatement of SI possible after 180 days for second cancer claim of unrelated type.
available_riders: Premium waiver after Major Stage Cancer
claim_process_summary: Submit diagnosis certificate, histopathology report, treating doctor's confirmation. Lump-sum payment within 30 days of complete claim documentation. Survival period of 30 days typically required.
